name: Series and Approximation
description: Approximate hard functions with polynomials and learn how far to trust them.

lessonNames.l1-tangent-approx: The tangent line as an approximation
lessonNames.l12-log-vs-simple: Why log returns are close to simple returns

lessonObjectives.l1-tangent-approx: Approximate a function near a point with its tangent line.
lessonObjectives.l2-how-wrong: Measure the error of a linear approximation and watch it shrink.
lessonObjectives.l3-newton: Find a root by following tangent lines, and see when it fails.
lessonObjectives.l4-duration: Approximate a bond’s price change with its first derivative.
lessonObjectives.l5-curvature-term: Build a quadratic approximation from the second derivative.
lessonObjectives.l6-matching-derivatives: Build a Taylor polynomial of any order by matching derivatives.
lessonObjectives.l7-standard-series: Derive the Maclaurin series of $e^x$, $\sin x$, $\cos x$, $\ln(1 + x)$ and $1/(1 - x)$.
lessonObjectives.l8-convexity: Improve a bond price approximation with the second-order term.
lessonObjectives.l9-does-it-add-up: Test a series for convergence with comparison and ratio tests.
lessonObjectives.l10-how-far: Find the radius of convergence of a power series.
lessonObjectives.l11-bounding-error: Bound the error of a Taylor polynomial with the remainder term.
lessonObjectives.l12-log-vs-simple: Use $\ln(1 + r) \approx r$ and say when it breaks down.
